email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Retail Sales Associate role at waterdrop®. Your mission to make hydration fun and your innovative Microdrinks immediately caught my attention. With a background in digital marketing and web development, I've honed strong communication, problem-solving, and customer-focused skills that translate seamlessly to retail.

In my freelance work and at Episto, I've built and optimized websites, managed content, and used data to improve customer experiences. This has taught me to listen carefully, adapt quickly, and always keep the consumer in mind—qualities I'd bring to your store floor. I'm fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have conversational Dutch, which helps me connect with diverse customers.

I'm approachable, energetic, and eager to grow with waterdrop®. I'd love the chance to contribute to your team and help customers discover the joy of drinking more water.

Thank you for your consideration.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Retail Sales Associate position at waterdrop®. Your commitment to making hydration enjoyable through innovative Microdrinks resonates with me, and I would be thrilled to contribute to your store's success.

While my professional background is in digital marketing and web development, the core skills I've developed—clear communication, active listening, and a relentless focus on the customer—are directly applicable to retail. In my freelance work and at Episto, I've built and optimized websites, managed content, and used analytics to understand user behavior. This experience has taught me to identify needs, provide tailored solutions, and continuously improve based on feedback. For instance, I've resolved client issues promptly, collaborated with team members to achieve shared goals, and maintained a high standard of quality in every project.

I am approachable, energetic, and adaptable—qualities that align with your Retail Core Values. I thrive in dynamic environments and am always willing to go the extra mile. My ability to multitask and remain professional under pressure has been honed through managing multiple client projects simultaneously. I am fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have conversational Dutch, enabling me to connect with a diverse customer base.

I am eager to bring my customer-focused mindset and strong work ethic to waterdrop®. I am confident that my interpersonal skills and enthusiasm for excellent service will make a positive impact on your team and customers.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to waterdrop®.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
